title: Bare catch block in set-folder-dates.ts silently swallows errors, bypassing eslint catch-variable rule
description: Verified: scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:137 — `} catch {` with no error variable and no logging. This catch block handles failures from both `execFileSync('git', [..., 'log', ...])` and `fs.utimesSync(...)`. When git log fails (e.g., corrupted .git directory) or utimesSync fails (e.g., permission denied), the error is silently swallowed and the folder is marked 'skipped:no-commit'. The root eslint.config.js at line 59-61 enforces catch variables named 'err' via selector `CatchClause > Identifier[name!='err']`, but the bare catch (no variable at all) bypasses this rule because there is no CatchClause Identifier to match.
spec:
1. Change `} catch {` at scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:137 to `} catch (err)` to capture the error variable.
2. Add a `console.warn` logging the specific error before the skipped result: `console.warn(`Cannot process ${entry.name}: ${(err as Error).message}`)`.
3. Verify `bun run lint` passes after the change (catch variable `err` satisfies the ESLint catch-variable rule at eslint.config.js:59-61).
4. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes.
